# Filter rows where Head Coach is exactly "Carl Prause"
prause_seasons = df[df['Head Coach'] == 'Carl Prause']

# Get the unique seasons (years) for those rows
prause_years = prause_seasons['Season'].unique()

# Sort the years to find the first and last
first_year = prause_years.min()
last_year = prause_years.max()

# Calculate the length of service in years (inclusive)
service_length = last_year - first_year + 1

# Assign the answer
answer = service_length
